messages:
carmen: FYI console showed a sudden unit-cost spike for model-D during yesterday's rollback window. looks like a routing blip but want to capture here.
jules: saw that too. spike at ~2025-01-15T21:12Z for ~6m. unit cost jumped 40% then normalized.
harper: Do we have the micro-window payload? Could be a mix of cache misses + routing to a hotpath variant.
ken: Pulling logs now. initial look: at 21:10 a canary routed ~18% of traffic to model-D-quant, then at 21:14 we rolled back. telemetry windows are 5m so that split falls inside one window.
carmen: that's probably the cause. when variant mix changes mid-window our per-window amortization uses the cheaper variant baseline and misattributes savings -> spike.
jules: +1. Also noticed cached hits were zeroed in that window so denom shrank and unit cost inflated.
harper: Proposed fixes: (1) telemetry add compact variant_histogram per window (top-3 variants with counts) (2) return tokens_cached separately (tokens_total,tokens_cached) instead of setting tokens to zero on cache-hit.
ken: Implementation note: we already capture variant at request time; we can aggregate top-K in ingestion. payload size impact minimal if we cap K=3.
carmen: UX: in the dashboard tooltip show "variant mix" and a small explanation when a window has >1 variant. Also show a "recompute interest" button that attempts merged_ratio across raw windows.
jules: For short-term mitigation let's widen micro-window for the rollout panel from 5m->10m to reduce split bias. It's temporary but easy.
harper: Long-term: support client-side simulate pin/policy: if user pins to model-D (weight=100%) we recompute unit-cost using variant-level costs. This helps Sales and SREs to see impact.
ken: billing note: any UI-only amortization must be labelled non-billing. Don't change billing math without PM/legal.
carmen: Action items: ken to add variant_histogram + tokens_cached (INF-7801), harper to mock tooltip + simulate pin (INF-7802), jules to flip micro-window to 10m on the rollout card temporarily (INF-7803).
billing-bot: Tickets created: INF-7801, INF-7802, INF-7803.
